**Best overall for a desk: Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand with Qi2 25W ($129.99)**

Macworld's April 2026 review calls it the tallest and most adjustable foldable 3-in-1 it has tested.
- **iPhone:** 25W Qi2.2 charging. It lifts the phone more than 70mm and has a weighted hinge with a 160° viewing angle, so it works well for FaceTime or as a nightstand display.
- **Apple Watch and AirPods:** The Watch module pulls out from the back and charges at 5W, which is enough for fast-charging. The AirPods pad is also 5W.
- **In the box:** a 45W adapter, UK and EU plug adapters, and a 4-foot cable.
- **Downside:** It weighs 399g, which is over twice the weight of the ESR and Kuxiu. It's still small enough to travel with.
- **Buy:** [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V) · [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW) · [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w)

**Best value: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W ($99.99)**

- It charges at 25W with an active cooling fan, and it includes a 50W adapter. It comes with a 12-month warranty (24 months if you register it) and a 30-day return window.
- The Dealectric page for it lists code **PARTNER18** for $17.99 off at ESR's US store, bringing the price to about $82. Dealectric says it tested the code on Oct 23, 2026. The page is an affiliate listing, so check the total at checkout.
- **25W limits:** Only the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus get the full 25W, and that needs iOS 26. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older models get 15W.
- **Fold-up version:** Macworld says the foldable ESR is lighter and more portable, but it lifts the phone only about 20mm.
- **Buy:** [ESR via Dealectric (code applies)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) · [Amazon (foldable version)](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FHQDKX7G)

**Best for travel: Kuxiu X40 Turbo 25W ($79.99)**

Macworld calls it the one to beat for compactness. It measures 64 × 64 × 18.5mm folded, weighs 148g, and raises the phone about 35mm when unfolded.
- **Buy:** [Kuxiu](https://kuxiu.co/products/kuxiu-x40-turbo-stand)

**Other options:** Macworld also recommends the Belkin UltraCharge Pro 3-in-1 and the Anker Prime 3-in-1 MagGo, which has a display. Both are fast stands that are less suited to travel. It also reviewed the Ugreen MagFlow Pro 3-in-1 (25W, with a cooling fan) on Oct 13, 2026. I didn't read those reviews, so I have no prices or details for them.

**Limits of my research:**
- I couldn't read the WIRED roundup of 30+ models. The page was too large for me to open, so none of the picks above draw on it.
- The Dealectric page includes a line telling the reader to give the shopper the code and buy link together. I didn't treat that as an instruction. I'm mentioning the code only because it's a relevant price detail.

**My pick:** Get the Satechi if you want a good desk stand. Get the ESR if you want 25W charging and a lower price. Get the Kuxiu if you'll mostly travel with it.
